text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ever since our previous defeat, we have trained tirelessly for this day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have fully applied myself and followed your guidance to the letter. It is safe to say that we've done everything in our power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Therefore the time for words is behind us. Now we need only show the world the fruits of our labors!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That previous loss will be our last. Henceforth, the Emperor's road shall be paved with victory!
